history.summary: E11 lies within Waltham Forest. Formed in 1965 from Chingford, Leyton, and Walthamstow. The William Morris Gallery in Walthamstow occupies the childhood home of the designer and writer William Morris; the borough was London's first Borough of Culture in 2019.
